projects.title: Tody.app
projects.description:
Tody.app is a simple and modern task management application designed to improve daily productivity.
It allows users to create, manage, update, and complete tasks easily.
The app provides a clean and user-friendly interface for managing daily activities.
Flutter is used for the mobile application development.
Appwrite provides secure authentication and cloud-based data storage.
Tody.app helps users stay organized, focused, and productive every day.

projects.title: Convertix
projects.description:
Convertix is an offline file conversion app for Android that processes files directly on the user's device.
It currently supports PDF to JPG, Images to JPG, and Files to ZIP conversion.
The app focuses on privacy, simplicity, and fast local processing without uploading files to a server.
More file conversion and document tools can be added in future updates.
